short_description: Dual-laser Christie E3LH DLP with Dolby Vision HDR. 31 fL, 1,000,000:1 dynamic contrast, Atmos, power recliners with bass transducers. Current U.S. location count is generated from the Dolby Cinema finder snapshot in the site stats.

default_projection.contrast_notes: 1,000,000:1 is a Dolby Vision dynamic black-level claim via dual-pass DLP — not a conventional sequential measurement. Sequential contrast (~5,000–7,500:1) is the more comparable metric for cross-format comparison. SDR/non-Dolby Vision mode: ~16 fL, no dynamic contrast advantage.

known_limitations: Cannot display 1.43:1 IMAX content at full height — crops or presents with black bars
Screen typically ~50–60 ft wide — smaller physical scale than IMAX GT (~80–100 ft)
1,000,000:1 dynamic contrast applies only to Dolby Vision-graded content; SDR mode drops to ~16 fL and standard sequential contrast
New builds from May 2025 onward will use single-laser Christie system (lower brightness) — see dolby_cinema_single_laser preset
